findings.title: Stored wealth and acquired gain cannot take the person's place
findings.claim: The focus clause presents wealth and acquired gain as possible substitutes for the person and then denies that substitution: the consequence reaches him himself.
findings.mechanism: The availing verb is governed by the separated-person relation in عنه, while the repeated ما ... وما coordinates possessed property and acquired output under one negation. Exact failed-availing parallels in 92:11, 69:28, and 15:84 independently return the same resource-to-owner relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah becomes a test of surrogate protection, not only a report that money was unhelpful: both stored property and productive acquisition fail while the person remains directly exposed.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading that his wealth and what he earned did not avail him remains intact. The external parallels corroborate the focus relation; they do not turn every occurrence of wealth or earning into a substitute image or establish a wider doctrine beyond this activation.

epistemic.reason: A citable trusted finding supplies all three focus branches and the packet supplies exact focus carriers plus independent failed-availing target Arabic.

findings.claim: The later firewood carrier gives the open earned-result phrase a concrete late-arriving pressure: what is earned can be read as an effect put into circulation for another to bear, while the physical firewood image remains the supplied carrier.
findings.mechanism: The registered firewood facet is carried by the later 111:4 context, and the focus earning word is the independent trigger and return point. The retrospective record explicitly describes this late contact as changing the phrase from a ledger item into something placed into circulation for another to carry.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why the earned phrase opens after the later scene is supplied: its result has a bearer and a material load, so agency remains visible through what is carried.
findings.containment: Only the registered physical firewood facet is activated. Harmful speech, snaring, and other unregistered source citations remain outside this finding; the firewood is not claimed to be a literal form of earnings.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective reader record explicitly names the focus return and the later firewood carrier, but the late circulation arrow remains an attributed contextual inference.
